_about: Round 16 (2026-11-26): real recordings for common sounds (Anthony: 'yes on 6 too'). Current is the round 14 winner (layered effects, pro mix), every sound generated. Earlier rounds are in variants_round*.json and variants_layers.json. Round 17 (2026-11-26): Anthony asked to rebuild the whole thing from real recordings and generate only what the library lacks. Current is now the round 16 winner. Round 17b (2026-11-26): Anthony found the real recordings too quiet for many effects and asked for several levels to choose from.

variants.label: Real recordings, effects as before
variants.why: The version you just heard, unchanged, as the yardstick.

variants.label: Real recordings, effects a little louder
variants.why: All effects 4 dB louder against the music.

variants.label: Real recordings, effects louder
variants.why: All effects 8 dB louder against the music.

variants.label: Real recordings, the quiet effects brought up
variants.why: The loudest sound (the vacuum motor) stays about where it was; the quieter ones (feet, carpet, wire, air) come up 3 to 6 dB so they are not lost behind it. All effects 4 dB louder against the music.

variants.label: Real recordings, quiet effects up and key moments punchier
variants.why: Same as the one before, and the one-off moments (click, rip, thump, boom) 6 dB louder on top.
